entry.title: Onsager Algebras and Lattice Fermions
entry.summary:
We study the exact Onsager algebra of free lattice fermions in staggered, Wilson, and overlap incarnations, working in both Hamiltonian and Euclidean formulations in four spacetime dimensions. In each case, we show that the exact lattice algebra emanates the full chiral symmetry of the low-energy theory: if there are $N$ massless Dirac fermions in the continuum, the Onsager algebra reduces to a $U(2N)$ chiral symmetry. The details of which generators are quantised or ultra-local differ between formulations.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy #post-quantum

entry.title: Rank Ceiling for Twiddle-Perturbation Faults on the Forward NTT. NIST standardised ML-KEM and ML-DSA in 2024 for post-quantum key establishment and digital signatures.
entry.summary:
NIST standardised ML-KEM and ML-DSA in 2024 for post-quantum key establishment and digital signatures. Both compute forward number-theoretic transforms on secret polynomials. Their fixed multipliers, called twiddles, are a documented fault-attack target.

Source: IACR Cryptology ePrint Archive · Tags: #cryptography #zkp #post-quantum #formal-proofs
